@overview 字彙王 Level 3–5 練習題本。答案與中文詞義已與教材官方解答逐題核對；題目文字為照片轉錄。

@group A 文意字彙（1–5）：依提示寫出正確的字

Q 1 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Monica has been suffering from headaches for a while, and lately, she simply cannot e______e the pain anymore.
= endure
~詞義 endure（v.）忍受
~原文 Monica has been suffering from headaches for a while, and lately, she simply cannot endure the pain anymore.

Q 2 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: This popular video has been watched by millions of Internet users, and many of them have left c______ts under it, too.
= comments
~詞義 comment（n.）評論
~原文 This popular video has been watched by millions of Internet users, and many of them have left comments under it, too.

Q 3 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The US c______es more oil than any other country. On average, an American uses up seven liters of oil per day.
= consumes
~詞義 consume（v.）消耗
~原文 The US consumes more oil than any other country. On average, an American uses up seven liters of oil per day.

Q 4 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The artist gets a lot of i______n from ballet dancers. They bring her endless ideas to create her works.
= inspiration
~詞義 inspiration（n.）靈感
~原文 The artist gets a lot of inspiration from ballet dancers. They bring her endless ideas to create her works.

Q 5 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The restaurant serves a c______n of American and Asian foods because the chef admires both types of cuisine and wants to bring them together.
= combination
~詞義 combination（n.）結合;組合
~原文 The restaurant serves a combination of American and Asian foods because the chef admires both types of cuisine and wants to bring them together.

@group B 選擇題（6–10）

Q 6 | choice | 選擇題
stem: There are more than three hundred butterfly ______ found in Taiwan. That is why Taiwan is sometimes called the "Kingdom of Butterflies."
A: aspects
B: species
C: contents
D: disasters
= B
~詞義 species（n.）物種
~原文 There are more than three hundred butterfly species found in Taiwan. That is why Taiwan is sometimes called the "Kingdom of Butterflies."

Q 7 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Our geography teacher is taking us to observe the unique rock ______ on the east coast of Taiwan.
A: circumstances
B: predictions
C: households
D: formations
= D
~詞義 formation（n.）結構
~原文 Our geography teacher is taking us to observe the unique rock formations on the east coast of Taiwan.

Q 8 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The messages that this video clip is trying to ______ are that we should seize every moment and should also treasure the people around us.
A: equip
B: inspire
C: convey
D: predict
= C
~詞義 convey（v.）傳達
~原文 The messages that this video clip is trying to convey are that we should seize every moment and should also treasure the people around us.

Q 9 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Real happiness often ______ in appreciating small moments, like shared meals or quiet walks with friends.
A: suspects
B: entertains
C: contributes
D: consists
= D
~詞義 consist（v.）存在於
~原文 Real happiness often consists in appreciating small moments, like shared meals or quiet walks with friends.

Q 10 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Unable to afford the expensive concert tickets, Lily ______ herself with watching the live broadcast online and reading fan discussions afterward.
A: sited
B: interpreted
C: inspected
D: contented
= D
~詞義 content（v.）使滿足
~原文 Unable to afford the expensive concert tickets, Lily contented herself with watching the live broadcast online and reading fan discussions afterward.

@group C 配合題（11–15）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: status
B: nowadays
C: contribution
D: ruined
E: disguise
F: moreover

Q 11 | bank | 配合題
stem: The detective attended the festival in ______, hoping to observe the subject without revealing his identity.
= E
~詞義 disguise（n.）喬裝;偽裝
~原文 The detective attended the festival in disguise, hoping to observe the subject without revealing his identity.

Q 12 | bank | 配合題
stem: The Internet allows people ______ to be far more connected to the rest of the world than in the past.
= B
~詞義 nowadays（adv.）現在
~原文 The Internet allows people nowadays to be far more connected to the rest of the world than in the past.

Q 13 | bank | 配合題
stem: Einstein was awarded the Nobel Prize for his ______ to physics.
= C
~詞義 contribution（n.）貢獻
~原文 Einstein was awarded the Nobel Prize for his contribution to physics.

Q 14 | bank | 配合題
stem: This car has comfortable seats and a lot of storage space. ______, it is quite fuel-efficient.
= F
~詞義 moreover（adv.）此外
~原文 This car has comfortable seats and a lot of storage space. Moreover, it is quite fuel-efficient.

Q 15 | bank | 配合題
stem: I accidentally spilled red wine on my white shirt, and now it is completely ______.
= D
~詞義 ruin（adj.）毀壞
~原文 I accidentally spilled red wine on my white shirt, and now it is completely ruined.

@group C 配合題（16–20）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: launch
B: precise
C: spiritual
D: consumers
E: enormous
F: fragile

Q 16 | bank | 配合題
stem: Engineers worked tirelessly to ensure that they could ______ the rocket on schedule, despite several technical challenges.
= A
~詞義 launch（v.）發射
~原文 Engineers worked tirelessly to ensure that they could launch the rocket on schedule, despite several technical challenges.

Q 17 | bank | 配合題
stem: Many ______ are willing to wait in long lines to buy the latest electronics products.
= D
~詞義 consumer（n.）消費者
~原文 Many consumers are willing to wait in long lines to buy the latest electronics products.

Q 18 | bank | 配合題
stem: Mr. and Mrs. Lin have five children, so they spend a(n) ______ amount of money on food every month.
= E
~詞義 enormous（adj.）巨大的
~原文 Mr. and Mrs. Lin have five children, so they spend a(n) enormous amount of money on food every month.

Q 19 | bank | 配合題
stem: Please be careful when you handle that artwork, because it is very ______.
= F
~詞義 fragile（adj.）易碎的
~原文 Please be careful when you handle that artwork, because it is very fragile.

Q 20 | bank | 配合題
stem: The teacher gave clear and ______ instructions, and the students all completed their homework accordingly.
= B
~詞義 precise（adj.）精確的
~原文 The teacher gave clear and precise instructions, and the students all completed their homework accordingly.
